themes.title: Far-Right Election Contestation Following Brazilian Runoff Defeat
themes.blurb: Following the defeat of Flávio Bolsonaro in Brazil's presidential election, far-right networks across the Americas have rallied around claims of election fraud. The crisis has triggered cross-border diplomatic friction, with Bolsonaro fleeing to the United States via Argentina while Donald Trump and regional allies echoed claims of a rigged vote.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro fled to Miami after his election loss, claiming to be Brazil's rightful leader while alleging an electoral coup

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's administration faced internal division and judicial investigation over alleged assistance in Bolsonaro's flight through Argentina

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Donald Trump denounced the Brazilian election outcome as a disgrace while his supporters hosted Bolsonaro in Florida

themes.title: Populist Right Momentum Ahead of Elections
themes.blurb: Populist and right-wing parties across Europe are highlighting polling gains and local electoral successes to signal growing momentum. High-profile by-election victories and rising poll figures are being used to challenge mainstream parties ahead of upcoming regional and national contests.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe continue to condition government support and budget approval on strict national priority measures. Demands center on curbing immigration, reducing funding for foreign minors and NGOs, and deploying law enforcement or military assets to enforce border and internal security.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Attacked open border policies and challenged local council housing allocations for asylum seekers

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Demanded severe reductions in EU budget contributions and pushed hardline public security measures

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across multiple nations are alleging state overreach as judicial bodies and intelligence agencies target their leaders and infrastructure. Party figures frame legal disqualifications, court interrogations, and surveillance decisions as political persecution designed to hobble conservative opposition.
